key.name: panel-content
key.description: Which speeds the panel indicator shows: download and upload, only one of them, or their sum.

key.name: panel-style
key.description: Detailed shows full units, compact uses one-letter units, stacked shows download above upload.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Where in the top panel the indicator is placed.

key.name: show-units
key.description: Show the unit next to each speed in the panel.

key.name: use-bits
key.description: Show speeds in bits per second (Mbps) instead of bytes per second (MB/s).

key.name: binary-units
key.description: Use 1024-based units (KiB, MiB, GiB) instead of 1000-based units (KB, MB, GB).

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often, in seconds, network speed is sampled.

key.name: usage-tracking
key.description: Record how much data is downloaded and uploaded. When off, existing statistics are kept but nothing new is counted.

key.name: usage-retention-days
key.description: Number of days of daily usage history to keep.

key.name: usage-reset-request
key.description: Set by the preferences dialog to the current time (in seconds since the epoch) to ask the extension to erase all usage statistics.

key.name: usage-notifications
key.description: Notify when usage reaches the alert percentage of a data limit, and when the limit is reached.

key.name: daily-limit
key.description: Daily data limit in gigabytes (1 GB = 1000³ bytes). 0 disables daily alerts.

key.name: monthly-limit
key.description: Monthly data limit in gigabytes (1 GB = 1000³ bytes). 0 disables monthly alerts.

key.name: alert-percent
key.description: Percentage of a limit at which to warn, before the limit itself is reached.

key.name: connection-notifications
key.description: Notify when the network connection is lost, restored or switched, and when a VPN turns on or off.

key.name: manual-interface
key.description: Name of the network interface to monitor, such as "enp3s0". Empty to detect the active interface automatically.

key.name: history-range
key.description: The range shown by the history chart in the popup.

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: Write verbose diagnostic messages to the system journal.
